beats.say: You trained for years. You care for patients every day. And now, one exam stands between you and your nursing career in the Gulf Region.
Saudi, Qatar, Dubai or Abu Dhabi? Which questions will they ask? And on the day, will you really be ready?
Breathe. You already think like a safe nurse. We will help you show it. We have you.

beats.title: Four exams
beats.say: Pick your regulator. Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Dubai or Abu Dhabi. Each exam keeps its own progress. Set your exam date, and the studio suggests a daily pace.

beats.title: Question bank
beats.say: Answer, then see the reasoning. The safest choice, a clinical pearl, and the trap to avoid, on every question.

beats.title: Mock exams
beats.say: Train in tutor mode for instant feedback, or run a timed simulation of the real day, with answers hidden until the end.

beats.title: Decision tools
beats.say: Clinical decision tools, from stroke recognition to tubes and drains. Screen, decide, commit and reassess, and every tool comes with its own questions.

beats.title: Dossiers
beats.say: Practise the same reasoning inside full clinical stories. Thirty five specialty dossiers, each linked to the core tools you need.
imgs: Context, plus a rule you can reuse

beats.title: Language
beats.say: Nine labs show how licensing questions are built. And question language is explained side by side, in English and Arabic.

beats.title: Readiness
beats.say: See exactly where you stand, by domain. And when your head is full, a short reset matched to the problem.
Twelve hundred and ninety seven clinically reviewed questions. Sixty seven decision tools. Three hundred and fifty cases.
Start with free questions today. The Gulf Pass opens all four exams, plus the Crown Pass. One safe decision at a time.
